plugin.name: Splinter Cell Pandora Tomorrow Widescreen Fix
ResX.description: Use 0 to select the desktop resolution. Both dimensions must be set to override it.
ResY.description: Use 0 to select the desktop resolution. Both dimensions must be set to override it.
RawInputMouse.description: Read mouse movement without the original dropped events. Restart required.
RawInputMouseRawData.description: Use unaccelerated mouse movement. Restart required.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Fill widescreen displays with movies, or keep their original 4:3 presentation.
HudWidescreenMode.description: Keep the HUD centered, move supported elements toward the screen edges, or stretch the HUD.
OpsatWidescreenMode.description: Stretch the OPSAT background across the widescreen display.
ScopeWidescreenMode.description: Move sniper scope textures toward the widescreen display edges.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Use Auto, 16:9, 21:9, or a custom ratio to constrain the HUD.
PostProcessFixedScale.description: Use 0 for the original resolution, 1 for the screen width, or a custom pixel size. Shadows and reflections are capped at 2048 for stability.
GrainScale.description: Scale vision grain for the screen resolution. 1 uses the corrected 640x480 baseline; 0 keeps the original grain scale.
ShadowMapResolution.description: Use 0 for the original resolution, 1 for the screen width, or a custom pixel size. Shadows and reflections are capped at 2048 for stability.
ReflectionsResolution.description: Use 0 for the original resolution, 1 for the screen width, or a custom pixel size. Shadows and reflections are capped at 2048 for stability.
LightDistanceMultiplier.description: Increase the distance at which dynamic lights and shadows remain active. 1 keeps the original distance.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the intro logos when the game starts.
SkipPressStartToContinue.description: Skip the initial Press Enter to Continue prompt.
RestoreCutsceneFOV.description: Use the original field of view during in-engine cutscenes.
CutsceneBorders.description: Keep cutscene borders, hide them, or size them according to the screen aspect ratio.
EnableConsole.description: Restore the developer console. Press the tilde key to open it.
EnableCheckpoints.description: Restore the checkpoint behavior from the Xbox release.
DeferredInput.description: Queue input events for the game to consume on its own thread. Disable only to diagnose input compatibility.
BloomResolutionMultiplier.description: Multiply the bloom render-target resolution. 0 keeps the original resolution; larger values increase GPU and memory use.
FPSLimit.description: Use 0 for no limit. 60 FPS is recommended; higher rates can affect AI and physics.
GogglesLightColor.description: Packed RGB color (0xRRGGBB); 0 keeps the original goggles color.

menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language tag for Advanced Options and other plugins. auto follows the game language. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Advanced Options.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a centered window, or borderless covering the monitor. Takes effect when the game starts. Alt+Enter switches fullscreen and the chosen window style.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the normal gameplay camera field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Scripted, aiming and gadget cameras keep their own framing.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings. Press twice to confirm.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset and press twice to apply it to this plugin.
MouseSensitivity.description: Movement multiplier for raw mouse input. Applies immediately; presets preserve your choice.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Auto uses the full screen width. Set a ratio such as 4:3, 16:9 or 21:9 to keep the HUD in a centered area. Applies immediately.
MAIN.FMVWidescreenMode.description: Keep the original video framing, crop to fill the screen, or stretch to the screen. Applies immediately.
menu.rawmouse.label: Raw mouse input
menu.rawmouse.help: Avoid dropped mouse events. Restart needed.
menu.rawdata.label: Raw mouse data
menu.rawsensitivity.label: Raw sensitivity
menu.rawsensitivity.help: Raw mouse speed. Live; presets keep it.
